wave: TOKYO PRIORITY D PERFORMANCE VENUES — 3-VENUE BOUNDED PRODUCTION IMPLEMENTATION
phase: Bounded implementation of the three ADOPTs from the TOKYO PRIORITY D PERFORMANCE-IDENTITY PREFLIGHT (2026-09-10), run as three independent mini-waves inside one batch.
scopeBoundary: Only tokyo-official-0690, tokyo-official-0740 and tokyo-official-0105 were opened. No rank-4/rank-5 preflight research, no GMO, RaiBoC, 日野市民会館大ホール, and no existing blocked/HARD-CASE record was opened or changed. No existing production venue's data, fingerprint or generated artifact changed.
methodPolicy: For each venue the current issuer page was re-checked first, the current-linked chart was re-fetched from that page and hashed, DENSE-VECTOR eligibility was decided from the actual asset (none of the three qualified), and a fresh independent human visual two-pass was frozen pass by pass before any machine expansion. Comparison required bidirectional equality on the expanded (area,row,seat) set. Issuer subtotals were used only as post-freeze reconciliation, never as a transcription target. No capacity fitting, unprinted-identifier inference, neighbouring-row propagation, geometry completion, symmetry-derived seat IDs, third-party completion, or configuration mixing was used anywhere in this wave.

venues.venue: 紀伊國屋サザンシアターTAKASHIMAYA
venues.chartProvenance: Reached from the current operator theatre-use guide (https://store.kinokuniya.co.jp/theater/guide-southerntheater/ ), which links it under 【客席】. The guide is actively maintained (its equipment-list PDFs were refreshed in 2026-09). Chart SHA-256 dc5a8e2adcd707745d92bf885be433e828b27e601f9c590f471930f8cd9be19b, 928,355 bytes, PDF 1.3, one page, 547.2x793.8pt; re-fetched byte-identical immediately before Pass 2.
venues.denseVectorEligibility: Not eligible. The page carries no fonts and no vector drawings: it is one embedded 1520x2205 raster JPEG, and text extraction returns 0 characters.
venues.verificationMethod: Fresh independent human visual two-pass on the current-linked official chart, plus an independent raster seat-cell structural checksum, issuer printed-total reconciliation, and a left/right block symmetry invariant.
venues.pass1: Rows 1->21 ascending, left->centre->right within each row, from the native 1520x2205 JPEG upscaled 2x in full-width band crops. 468 seats.
venues.pass2: Rows 21->1 descending, right->centre->left, from an independently re-fetched byte-identical PDF re-rendered at 420dpi (3192x4631) in block-column crops. 468 seats.
venues.structuralChecksum: Independent raster path over the chart image only: white connected components filtered to seat-cell shape (area 700-2200px, 25-50px wide, 35-60px tall, which also rejects the 53x48 corner door arcs), then per-zone robust row-slope estimation and banding. It returned 21 bands per zone with left 2,4,4,5,5,6x14,5,5; centre 12,11,12,11,...,12,11,10; right 2,4,4,5,5,6x14,5,5; 468 cells total. All 63 block counts matched the human two-pass exactly.
venues.issuerReconciliation: The chart itself prints 座席表 (客席数468). Mapped set 468 — exact match. The issuer publishes no per-area subtotal, so no area-level reconciliation applies.
venues.accessibilitySemantics: The chart footnote prints 「※14列3〜6番の座席は車椅子専用スペースとして使用することができます」 and draws those four cells inside one heavy bold rectangle. The issuer defines an optional re-use of printed seat numbers only: no replacement relation, no companion seats, and no alternate numbering are published. All four are kept as printed standard-configuration seats; wheelchairSemantics is not-reflected with accessibilityConversionNotReflected true.
venues.areas: single main area; rows 1列-21列; printed gaps (18 on even rows; 6/18/19 on 20列; 6/17/18/19 on 21列) held as excluded

venues.chartProvenance: Reached from the current PARCO劇場 page (https://stage.parco.jp/parcotheater/ ), 座席表 section, for the rebuilt theatre at 渋谷PARCO 8F. Chart SHA-256 379d328ce2bd3a1fed0684b1efa1a7d0c396e27efc3b29e4077bdb5824dfef81, 360,015 bytes, PDF 1.5, one page, title 「PARCO劇場座席表」; re-fetched byte-identical immediately before Pass 2. The historical 458-seat theatre was excluded entirely.
venues.denseVectorEligibility: Not eligible. The page is all-vector but the only extractable text is the 15 characters of the door labels 「1 扉」〜「4 扉」; seat numbers and row letters are drawn as vector outlines, so the requirement that every seat identifier be printed as text is not met.
venues.verificationMethod: Fresh independent human visual two-pass on the current-linked official chart, plus an independent PDF vector structural checksum, issuer-published total reconciliation, a left/right mirror symmetry invariant, and a geometric side-block row-assignment separation check.
venues.pass1: Rows A->T ascending, left->centre->right, rendered at 500dpi (4134x5847). 636 seats.
venues.pass2: Rows T->A descending, right->centre->left, from an independently re-fetched byte-identical PDF rendered at 300dpi (2481x3508) in block-column crops. 636 seats.
venues.structuralChecksum: Independent vector path over the PDF drawing operators only: each seat block is one closed rect (20 centre blocks) or rotated quad (36 side blocks) and the seats inside are separated by 10-20pt single line segments, so seats = interior dividers + 1. It returned 20 centre blocks alternating 16,15; 18 left and 18 right side blocks (B-L: 5,6,6,7,7,8,8,9,9,9,10; M-S: 10,11,11,11,12,12,12); 580 divider segments; 636 seats (580+56=636). All 56 block counts matched the human two-pass exactly.
venues.sideBlockRowIdentity: The chart prints the row letter only beside the centre block; the side blocks carry no printed row letter. Their row identity was not inferred from sequence. Both human passes independently found 11 side blocks per side above the aisle against 12 row letters (A-L) and 7 below against 8 (M-T), with the rearmost aligning to L and S, so rows A and T have no side seats. The vector geometry then confirmed it independently: every one of the 18 side blocks sits within 6.1pt of its assigned row's centre block and no closer than 14.1pt to the runner-up row, against a ~20pt row pitch.
venues.issuerReconciliation: 株式会社パルコ's own news release publishes 客席数 636席 for the new theatre against 458席 for the old one. Mapped set 636 — exact match. No per-area subtotal is published.
venues.accessibilitySemantics: The current page requires a wheelchair user to buy a normal numbered ticket first and then contact the performance's wheelchair-space desk, noting that they may have to sit in the seat they bought. No permanent number-level replacement is published. The chart's two blue wheelchair-pictogram areas merely overlay printed cells (left M3, M4, N2, N3; right M37, M38, N38, N39); neither the number of spaces nor any mapping is printed. All eight are kept as printed seats; wheelchairSemantics is not-reflected with accessibilityConversionNotReflected true. Hearing-loop areas are likewise undefined at the number level and are not reflected.
venues.areas: single main area; rows A-T; the 28 that is unprinted on B/D/F/H/J/L/N/P/R held as excluded

venues.chartProvenance: Reached from the current operator seating page (https://mitsukoshi.mistore.jp/bunka/theater/about_sp.html ), which states 「客席数は514席(1階402席・2階112席)でございます。」 and carries the numbered map. Chart SHA-256 413760c6015d10808845efdf82d4f75e68a9e688467d9472fcff1babeb064750, 65,214 bytes, 725x916 palette PNG; re-fetched byte-identical immediately before Pass 2. The page's seat_pic.jpg (360x240) is an auditorium photograph, not the numbered chart, and was not used.
venues.denseVectorEligibility: Not eligible. The chart is published only as a raster PNG; seat numbers are not extractable text.
venues.verificationMethod: Fresh independent human visual two-pass on the current official chart, issuer per-floor subtotal reconciliation, the issuer's own viewpoint definition for the nine icon-covered identifiers, and a partial machine structural skeleton checksum with a recorded reason why a full per-cell machine count is not practical on this asset.
venues.pass1: 1F rows 1->17 then 2F rows A->E, left->centre-left->centre-right->right, RGB upscaled 3x LANCZOS in band crops. 1F 402, 2F 112, total 514.
venues.pass2: 2F rows E->A first, then 1F right->left->centre-left->centre-right columns, each read 17->1 descending, from an independently re-fetched byte-identical PNG converted to greyscale and upscaled 5x BICUBIC in column crops. 1F 402, 2F 112, total 514.
venues.structuralChecksum: Independent raster path over the chart image only. It confirmed 17 1F row bands with 4 printed blocks each, 5 2F row bands, and a uniform measured cell pitch of 17.5px, with no contradiction against the human two-pass. A full per-cell machine count was judged not practical on this asset and the reason recorded: (1) the chart is published only as a 725x916 raster whose cell outlines are anti-aliased and partly dotted, so any binarisation threshold that recovers the faint borders also admits the seat-number digits as the same class; (2) the 1F front section is a curved fan in which each printed block has its own tilt, so neither a floor-level nor a row-level deskew recovers it; (3) nine cells have the viewpoint icons baked over their outlines. Per VENUE_DATA_GUIDE cross-check requirement item 4, the issuer's per-floor published values and the issuer's own viewpoint definition were used as the independent checksums instead. No threshold was tuned toward a target.
venues.occludedIdentifiers: Nine seat cells are covered by the page's red viewpoint icons, which are baked into the chart image; both passes independently found the same nine. Their identifiers were not inferred from sequence: the same current page loads the issuer's own viewsample.js, which maps each icon's coordinates to a named viewpoint asset — 1F 1列6番, 1列12番, 5列13番, 7列24番, 11列12番, 15列1番, 17列13番 and 2F A列12番, E列1番. Each named seat is exactly the cell its icon covers, and all nine assets return HTTP 200.
venues.issuerReconciliation: The issuer states 514 total = 1F 402 + 2F 112, and the chart itself prints 総席数514席 / 1F 402席 / 2F 112席. Mapped set: 1F 402, 2F 112, total 514 — every floor subtotal and the total match exactly. 1F breaks down as 1列 20 (3-22番), 2列 22 (2-23番) and 3列-17列 24 each = 402; 2F as A-D 24 each plus E 16 = 112.
venues.accessibilitySemantics: No wheelchair position, count, replacement relation or movable-seat statement appears on any current issuer theatre, seating, access or rental page checked on 2026-09-10, and the chart prints none. The absence is not treated as proof that none exists; nothing was inferred, and printed seats are registered as they are. wheelchairSemantics is not-reflected with accessibilityConversionNotReflected true.
venues.eventDependentNote: The chart prints 「公演により1列目を使用せず2列目が最前列になる場合がございます。また花道および仮設舞台を使用する公演など、座席配置を変更する場合がございます。」. The issuer publishes no per-performance numbered chart, so only the standard configuration is registered and no event-specific variant was created.
venues.areas: issuer-defined floors kept as areas: floor1 (1階) 402 and floor2 (2階) 112; 1F rows 1列-17列, 2F rows A列-E列; 2F E列 split into 1-12番 and 21-24番 by the 照明・音響室
